BOOK ONE · LESSON 135

The latest report

最新消息

A story lesson about a newspaper report on actress Karen Marsh. Karen told reporters that she might retire, that she couldn't make up her mind, that she would have to ask her future husband, and that her future husband would not let her make another film. The lesson introduces the use of 'would' and 'would have to' in reported speech. The workbook drills reported-speech comprehension questions about the story and vocabulary fill-in; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences using 'said'/'told' with 'would', completes a dialogue with reported-speech words, and rewrites 'would have to' sentences in reported speech.

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and then answer the question that follows. 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

The latest report. 最新消息。The latest newspaper report about Karen Marsh says: 'Karen Marsh has just arrived at her London hotel. She told reporters that she might retire. She couldn't make up her mind. She said that she would have to ask her future husband. Her future husband, the actor Michael Jones, said that he would not let her make another film.' 最新关于卡伦·马什的报纸报道说：「卡伦·马什刚到她的伦敦旅馆。她告诉记者说她可能要退休。她拿不定主意。她说她不得不问问她的未婚夫。她的未婚夫，演员迈克尔·琼斯说，他决不会让她再拍别的电影。」

最新消息。最新关于卡伦·马什的报纸报道说：「卡伦·马什刚到她的伦敦旅馆。她告诉记者说她可能要退休。她拿不定主意。她说她不得不问问她的未婚夫。她的未婚夫，演员迈克尔·琼斯说，他决不会让她再拍别的电影。」

Question: 问题。Who told reporters that she might retire? 谁告诉记者说她可能要退休？

问题：谁告诉记者说她可能要退休？

New words & expressions 生词和短语

reporter /rɪˈpɔːtə(r)/
n. 记者
retire /rɪˈtaɪə(r)/
v. 退休
make up one's mind
phr. 拿定主意
future husband
n. phr. 未婚夫

Notes on the text 课文注释

would 在间接引语中的用法

在间接引语中，will 变为 would：She said (that) she would retire. / She told reporters (that) she might retire.

would have to

「不得不」在间接引语中用 would have to：She said that she would have to ask her future husband.

might 的用法

「可能」在间接引语中可以用 might：She told reporters that she might retire.
